objective: Improve anomaly discrimination and timely alarms on BOTH missions; a negative result is valid.
historical_benchmark: EXP012 unchanged; reuse completed reports, zero old-model fits or replay.
exposure: NASA TEST labels and final TRAIN have been historically exposed. New NASA results are exploratory retrospective evidence, never independent confirmation.
entities: 81 original entities:27 MSL,54 SMAP, first P-2 label row. One telemetry target plus command features per file; no graph edges or windows across unaligned entities.
normalization: FIT float64 telemetry mean/std per entity, std floor0.001; unchanged command values. Published models additionally use pooled FIT-only StandardScaler on all input dimensions.
architecture: Shared per-mission TCN32 with RF63, entity embedding8, command embedding32, top4 learned command neighbours plus null, telemetry-independent reference. Observed telemetry representation and residual summaries feed a synthetic fault discriminator. Strict one-sided score at t; commands only through t-1.
published_models: GDN official architecture, FIT-only score normalization adaptation
CATCH official forward/loss/native frequency score, causal right-edge adapter
published_fit_policy: One model per mission trained over individual entity windows; never boundary concatenations. Common chronological FIT/STOP and common detector. These are controlled NASA adaptations, NOT reproductions of published leaderboard scores. GDN30 epochs/batch32 from pinned run.sh; CATCH5 MSL/10 SMAP epochs/batch128 from pinned mission scripts. Fixed seed17, no seed uncertainty claim for these baselines.

non_reproduced_methods.STGLR: No official source located and paper underspecifies a faithful VAE/attention/graph implementation; published point-adjusted numbers are not commensurable. Excluded with documented fidelity gap.
non_reproduced_methods.OmniAnomaly: Official Python3.5/3.6 TensorFlow/TFSnippet environment is incompatible with the single modern Colab workflow; no unvalidated Torch approximation. CATCH chosen as the agreed alternative.

synthetic_training_amplitudes: uniform0.5:4 FIT std units, random sign; contextual swap from another FIT window in the same batch
selection_durations: Spike1; other families16/64. CONF spike1; other families48/96. Requested long events shorten by the declared short-segment rule.
short_segment_rule: Duration=min(requested,max(1,(segment_length-16)//2)); retain requested/effective lengths. Unchanged injections invalid, reported separately, never count as a hit.
selection: Seed17 only. Equal-family average of .5 incremental event recall + .5 strict point F0.5. Background overlap, unconditional hits, conditional clean-window hits and incremental hits kept separate. Identical normal/injected random mask seeds for CATCH.
no_feasible_policy: Report NO_FEASIBLE_CANDIDATE; freeze q0.999/span1 solely as a diagnostic, never certify it or select a winner from NASA results.
thresholds: Per-entity, per-model, per-seed thresholds from clean80:90% TRAIN only, higher quantile and strict greater-than. No TEST distribution moments, threshold adaptation, smoothing change, PA, alarm merging, interval expansion, best-TEST threshold or seed selection.
freeze: All code, input identities, selected model states, source pins, candidate decisions and thresholds sealed BEFORE synthetic confirmation and BEFORE opening NASA TEST arrays.
metrics: Unmodified EXP012 metric implementation: corrected event F0.5 and event P/R; strict point P/R/F0.5/F1; per-channel tied-score AP then macro with denominator; nominal occupancy, starts per1000 nominal, event notification timing. New scores issued at target t; historical batch issue delays preserved in completed reports. No point adjustment.
statistics: Paired channel bootstrap, seeds grouped,10000 draws, seed20261006. Four primary graph-minus-removal/fusion contrasts across2 missions:98.75% descriptive intervals. Old LSTM/GDN/CATCH exploratory95% intervals. Shared mission models/channels and historical exposure limit inference; no independent NASA significance claim.
claim_rule: Synthetic mechanism confirmation can support only synthetic discrimination. NASA improvement requires both missions and adequate alarm burden, but remains retrospective exploratory even with positive intervals. No deployment/SOTA claim; independent real-anomaly confirmation remains outstanding.
compute: 18 new shared-model fits +4 published shared-model fits, default22. No architecture sweep. All active I/O local/content. FP32, no AMP/TF32/compile, deterministic algorithms, single thread. Full GPU runtime self-test before training.
resume: Epoch-boundary optimizer, mask gradient, loader and RNG snapshots; selected-state hashes; completed stages skipped only after byte verification. Environment/code/data drift aborts. No post-freeze fit/selection. Snapshots include selected weights and stage manifests.
label_gate: Successful complete score-seal verification before requesting and opening exact historical NASA label CSV. Labels file must have SHA256057ce2d6c8875982bf4e5404aefea14efdcbce413d80826d2b737c95b59b7539. Reject duplicates except canonical firstP-2, preserve104 original events.
inherited_preprocessing: The official telemanom README states the supplied telemetry arrays were pre-scaled using TEST min/max. EXP013 does not fit new transforms on TEST, but cannot undo inherited preprocessing or certify a raw-data leakage-free benchmark. Scale floor0.001 is numerical in supplied units, not physical sensor resolution.
graph_interpretation: Within-file command module slots and one telemetry target, not an aligned multivariate telemetry network across entities. Shared per-mission slot embeddings use the mission encoding convention described by Hundman; anonymized module identifiers are unavailable, so learned edges are statistical, not physical topology.
decision_rule: Prespecified graph-vs-removal/fusion paired synthetic objective comparisons on held-out variance/oscillation families,98.75% descriptive channel-bootstrap intervals across four contrasts, plus CAL selection and CONF nominal alarm gates. Positive synthetic evidence supports only the injected mechanisms. NASA pointF0.5/F1, corrected eventF0.5 and alarm burden are jointly reported without TEST-driven winner selection; any apparent improvement is retrospective only.
graph_FIT_support: New graph and fusion use only within-entity command slots varying in FIT, stored as a model buffer. Inactive slots are zeroed and excluded from graph top-k; null message handles zero eligible commands. No TEST support selection.
published_short_FIT_support: CATCH lookback191 means D-12 FIT187 contributes zero native training windows. Shared MSL model remains trained on other entities and evaluates D-12 without substituting a shorter sequence. Per-channel FIT/STOP window counts and zero-window entities are reported.
additional_statistics: Point precision/recall/F0.5/F1 and nominal occupancy paired differences use same grouped channel bootstrap draws with exploratory95% descriptive intervals, no additional multiplicity correction, undefined draws reported. No confirmatory significance claim.
blinding_scope: NASA annotation CSV excluded; preserved historical reports include label-derived outcomes/event metadata. Not physical isolation from historical label information. New training/selection/scoring ignore archived event intervals; new annotation CSV parsing is gated after verified score seal. Prior exposure remains declared.
